name: print-social-crimson-and-cream-liquid-swirl-pattern
title: Two-colour crimson and cream fluid swirl pattern with scattered dots
whatItIs: A portrait pattern of thick flowing cream ribbons winding through a deep red background, punctuated by cream circles and small dots.
whatItMeans: Groovy and warm; only two colours keep a busy pattern bold and clean.
techniques: Use thick organic curves in two colours.
Add circles of varying sizes as punctuation.
Let shapes bleed off the edges.
Use it as a wrap, background or packaging pattern.

vocabulary.definition: A pattern extending beyond the edges.
